2607.03007.title: Back to Basics: Improving Molecular Understanding in LLMs via SMILES-Graph Translation
2607.03007.paper_summary: Recent advances in molecular large language models have led to strong performance on molecular understanding and generation tasks, yet these gains often come without reliable structural grounding. In particular, existing approaches conflict with the chemistry principle that structure determines function: despite their downstream success, current molecular LLMs perform poorly on basic structure recognition, suggesting that they fail to capture molecular graphs from canonical SMILES. To remedy this, we propose MolBasic, a structure-first framework that strengthens structural comprehension via SMILES-Graph translation. MolBasic is built around a multi-level structure perception benchmark, where bidirectional SMILES-Graph conversion serves as the core task to align sequential and topological representations. On top of this foundation, we employ a progressive learning scheme with a standardized Chain-of-Thought (CoT) to steer models from structure acquisition toward higher-level molecular reasoning. Experiments show that MolBasic substantially improves structural understanding and yields robust gains on downstream tasks, including property prediction and objective optimization, supporting our structure-first paradigm.
2607.03007.paper_summary_zh: 最近在分子大型語言模型方面的進展使得在分子理解和生成任務上取得了強勁的表現，然而這些進步往往缺乏可靠的結構基礎。<lb/>特別是，現有的方法與化學原則相矛盾，即結構決定功能：儘管它們在下游任務中取得了成功，但目前的分子LLM在基本結構識別上表現不佳，這表明它們未能從標準SMILES中捕捉分子圖。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了MolBasic，一個以結構為先的框架，通過SMILES-圖轉換來加強結構理解。<lb/>MolBasic圍繞一個多層次的結構感知基準構建，其中雙向SMILES-圖轉換作為核心任務，以對齊序列和拓撲表示。<lb/>在這一基礎上，我們採用一種漸進式學習方案，結合標準化的思維鏈（CoT），引導模型從結構獲取轉向更高層次的分子推理。<lb/>實驗表明，MolBasic顯著改善了結構理解，並在下游任務中產生了穩健的增益，包括性質預測和目標優化，支持我們的結構優先範式。
